hooks.command:
/bin/sh -c '
emit_continue() {
  printf "%s\n" "{\"continue\":true,\"suppressOutput\":true}"
}

find_python() {
  for candidate in "${CODEX_UX_PYTHON:-}" \
    "$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3" \
    /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 \
    /usr/local/bin/python3 \
    /usr/bin/python3 \
    python3
  do
    [ -n "$candidate" ] || continue
    if command -v "$candidate" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$candidate" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf "%s\n" "$candidate"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

find_upward_hook() {
  dir=$PWD
  while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
    for candidate in \
      "$dir/.codex/codex-ux-file-browser-autostart/hook.py" \
      "$dir/plugins/codex-ux/hooks/codex-ux-file-browser-autostart/hook.py"
    do
      if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then
        printf "%s\n" "$candidate"
        return 0
      fi
    done
    dir=$(dirname "$dir")
  done
  return 1
}

find_installed_hook() {
  for base in "$HOME/.codex/plugins/codex-ux" "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache"; do
    [ -d "$base" ] || continue
    found=$(find "$base" -path "*/hooks/codex-ux-file-browser-autostart/hook.py" -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "$found" ]; then
      printf "%s\n" "$found"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

python_bin=$(find_python) || { emit_continue; exit 0; }
hook_path=$(find_upward_hook || find_installed_hook) || { emit_continue; exit 0; }
exec "$python_bin" "$hook_path"
'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking Codex UX File Browser trigger
